QUOTE: "Unless `MBEDTLS_ALLOW_PRIVATE_ACCESS` is defined, it expands to `private_##member`, so the field is renamed in the public header." and "`MBEDTLS_PRIVATE(x)` becomes plain `x`" (opt-out table), "Defining `MBEDTLS_ALLOW_PRIVATE_ACCESS` ... switches the guard off"
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer states the default rename to private_<member> and that defining the opt-out macro makes it expand to the plain member name.
